競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: 分離時の税務契約などをDuPont・Dowと結ぶ
relations.text_en: Bound with DuPont and Dow by separation tax agreements

source.label: DuPont 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: In connection with the separations and DWDP Distributions, DuPont, Dow and Corteva have entered into a Tax Matters Agreement

relations.text: 分離時の契約で相互補償・債務分担を定める
relations.text_en: Separation agreements set cross-indemnities and shared liabilities

source.label: Dow 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Includes charges associated with agreements entered into with DuPont and Corteva as part of the separation and distribution

relations.text: Chemoursの分離契約の相手EIDはCorteva子会社
relations.text_en: EID, party to Chemours' separation agreements, is a Corteva subsidiary

source.label: Chemours 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: EID is now a subsidiary of Corteva, and, at this time, any agreements related to our Separation are between us and EID, Corteva, and DuPont.

relations.text: バイオ燃料の折半合弁Etlasを設立
relations.text_en: Formed the Etlas 50:50 biofuels joint venture

source.label: BP 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Partnering in biofuels bp and Corteva, one of the world's leading agriscience companies, launched Etlas - a new biofuels 50:50 joint venture.

companies.name: アルカディア・バイオサイエンシズ

relations.text: 小麦の形質をCortevaに400万ドルで売却(2024年5月)
relations.text_en: Sold its resistant starch wheat trait to Corteva for $4.0 million (May 2024)

source.label: Arcadia Biosciences 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: On May 14, 2024, Arcadia sold its non-GMO Resistant Starch ("RS") durum wheat trait to longtime partner Corteva Agriscience ("Corteva") for total cash consideration of $4.0 million.

relations.text: 子会社Lavie Bioの生物殺菌剤をCortevaにライセンス
relations.text_en: Its Lavie Bio unit licenses a bio-fungicide to Corteva

source.label: Evogene 20-F(2024年度)
source.quote: payments under a licensing agreement of Lavie Bio with Corteva

companies.name: カリブー・バイオサイエンシズ

relations.text: 旧Pioneer(現Corteva)とゲノム編集の協業・ライセンス契約
relations.text_en: Collaboration and license agreement with Pioneer, now Corteva

source.label: Caribou Biosciences 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On July 13, 2015, we entered into an Amended and Restated Collaboration and License Agreement (as amended, "Pioneer Agreement") with Pioneer (then a DuPont company)

companies.name: サンガモ・セラピューティクス

relations.text: ゲノム編集技術のライセンス先の一社
relations.text_en: One of its genome editing licensees

source.label: Sangamo Therapeutics 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: These license partners include Corteva AgriScience, formerly known as Dow AgroSciences LLC

companies.name: アメリカン・ウォーター・ワークス

relations.text: PFAS訴訟でCortevaなどと和解し、請求を提出
relations.text_en: Filed claims under PFAS settlements with Corteva and others

source.label: American Water Works 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: the Company timely submitted to the MDL court its Phase One claims forms under settlement agreements with defendants 3M Company, The Chemours Company, Corteva, Inc. and DuPont de Nemours, Inc.

relations.text: Cibusが10-Kで、有力な競合の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Cibus names Corteva among its most likely competitors

source.label: Cibus 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: including BASF, Bayer Crop Science, Corteva AgriScience, and Syngenta
